analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Widely
analysis.quote: We may share information, including Personal Data, to our affiliates and with trusted third parties that provide services for Equativ, such as hosting and internet connectivity, Demand-Side Partners (DSP), third-party data providers or advertisers, and anti-fraud tools providers.

analysis.headline: Partners Share Your Data
analysis.quote: When permitted we may also share data with trusted business partners in order to perform or enhance our products and services.

analysis.headline: Shares With Google
analysis.quote: Please not our network of Supply Partners includes a large variety of companies among which Google ; please refer to Google’s website in order to understand how Google uses information from sites or apps that use their services as well as cookies and similar technologies used by Google in their advertising products.

analysis.headline: Creates Your Advertising Profiles
analysis.quote: Create profiles for personalized advertising; Use profiles to select personalized advertising;

analysis.headline: Collects Your Precise Geolocation
analysis.quote: Under U.S privacy laws, we may have access to sensitive personal information such as precise geolocation in accordance with such laws.

analysis.headline: Links Your Devices
analysis.quote: Where and if applicable we may rely on use the following features within these purposes: match and combine data from other data sources, link different devices, use of precise geolocation.

analysis.headline: Keeps Your Data 13 Months
analysis.quote: Unless otherwise required by applicable laws, Personal Data will be retained for a maximum of 13 months.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Internationally
analysis.quote: Personal Data may be transferred to our affiliates or a partner located outside the EU/EEA including to third-countries for which the European Commission has not adopted an adequacy decision yet.

analysis.headline: Limits Your US Privacy Rights
analysis.quote: As we do not directly face End-Users, our client Publishers or Advertiser do, you will need to exercise such rights directly to such Publisher/Advertiser.
